_comment: Prediction layers for MALIBU3D figure 4. Each inherits its ground-truth
counterpart's palette via `like`, so a GT colour edit reaches both and the
two can never drift out of sync -- which matters because a prediction figure
is only readable if it uses exactly the same colours as the GT beside it.
The four habitat tasks are the subtle case. Ground truth ships as one
44-class `natural_habitat` field that we REMAP into each task; predictions
ship already in each task's own index space (verified: 92.5% identity
agreement, and no relabelling of the predicted classes fits better). So the
inherited `remap` is dropped with an explicit null -- applying it again
This file is loaded INSTEAD of malibu3d_extra.json, so it re-includes it by
extending the same layers. Regenerate with scripts/make_prediction_palettes.py
